svg.title: Illustrative architecture for an internal AI-powered analytics product
svg.desc: Employees connect through an application layer with three channels, down through an infra and orchestration layer with MCP tools including experiments and causal inference, an LLM gateway, and an eval layer, into a data platform layer with a semantic layer that includes a scoped text-to-SQL component and a data lake, with a governance layer connecting into the infra and data layers.

g.text: Responsible AI review, access control, audit
